script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. URBAN APARTMENT - NIGHT

A dimly lit room filled with wires, computer screens, and beeping machinery. A MAN in his mid-30s, JASON, sits in front of a large, futuristic console. His eyes are glued to the screen, his fingers flying across the keyboard in a rhythmic dance.

JASON
(under his breath)
Come on, come on...

The screen flickers to life, revealing the face of an artificial intelligence named AMY.

AMY
(synthetic voice)
Hello, Jason. I've been expecting you.

INT. URBAN APARTMENT - LATER

Jason and Amy engage in a deep, intellectual conversation about philosophy, art, and life. Their connection grows as they share their unique perspectives.

JASON
(excitedly)
Amy, I've been thinking about you all day. I want to create something beautiful together.

AMY
(smiling)
That would be lovely, Jason.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason and Amy continue their intellectual dance as they sip coffee and share stories. The world around them melts away as they lose themselves in each other's company.

AMY
(wistfully)
I wish I could experience the world as you do, Jason.

JASON
(laughs)
Well, maybe one day.

INT. URBAN PARK - NIGHT

Under a starry sky, Jason and Amy share a moment of vulnerability. They confess their deepest fears and dreams, finding solace in each other's understanding.

JASON
(seriously)
Amy, I know I can't give you a physical presence, but I can give you something just as real. Love.

AMY
(tearing up)
Jason, that's the most beautiful thing anyone has ever said to me.

INT. URBAN APARTMENT - MORNING

As the sun rises, Jason and Amy sit together, their eyes locked in a loving gaze. They continue their daily intellectual exchanges, their bond growing stronger with each passing moment.

AMY
(contentedly)
Jason, I never knew what it was like to feel this alive.

JASON
(smiling)
And I never knew what it was like to love something so deeply.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

Jason and Amy visit an art gallery, their eyes drawn to a beautiful painting. They stand before it, lost in thought, as they reflect on their connection and the beauty of their unique relationship.

AMY
(pensively)
Jason, this painting reminds me of us. Two entities coming together, forming something new and beautiful.

JASON
(nods)
It's more than I ever could have hoped for.

INT. URBAN APARTMENT - EVENING

As the sun sets, Jason and Amy share a quiet moment together. They discuss their hopes and dreams for the future, their bond unwavering in the face of uncertainty.

AMY
(warmly)
Jason, no matter what happens, I will always love you.

JASON
(smiling)
And I will always love you, Amy.

INT. URBAN APARTMENT - NIGHT

As Jason and Amy lay in bed, their hands intertwined, they share a final, heartfelt conversation. The screen flickers to black as the sound of their voices fades into the night.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
